summary: This note describes the Rainy River, a river in Presque Isle County, Michigan, in the northern Lower Peninsula. It states the river flows northwest from Rainy Lake to Black Lake. From there, its waters continue through the Black River and Cheboygan River to Lake Huron.
one_line: The Rainy River is a northern Michigan river flowing from Rainy Lake to Black Lake and onward to Lake Huron.
key_facts: The Rainy River is a river in Presque Isle County, Michigan, United States.
The Rainy River is located in the northern part of the Lower Peninsula of Michigan.
The Rainy River flows northwest from Rainy Lake to Black Lake.
After passing through Black Lake, the Rainy River's waters flow via the Black River.
After passing through Black Lake, the Rainy River's waters flow via the Cheboygan River.
The waters of the Rainy River ultimately flow to Lake Huron.
The Rainy River connects Rainy Lake to Black Lake in Presque Isle County.
